reason: Add zero-blocker and canonical ceremony-preflight acceptance gates.

values: AC-1: Every prior tail issue has a reviewed-green merge ancestral to the candidate and the current #525 report has zero unresolved release blockers
AC-2: Release notes describe the exact candidate without unsupported claims
AC-3: Explicit operator authorization identifies the candidate, tag, and release operation after canonical ceremony tests and check-only preflight pass
AC-4: Tag and published release resolve to the exact approved candidate
AC-5: Live readback and immutable receipt capture notes, tag, release URL or identifier, timestamps, hashes, and preflight results
AC-6: No feature implementation, unreviewed merge, skipped preflight, or unrelated cleanup occurs
